correction.reason: Direct disassembly shows a session-slot loop, room-coordinate equality checks, recipient filtering, message-template selection, per-recipient output, and a recipient count return. No token scan, command table, abbreviation comparison, or handler pointer dispatch occurs in this function.

proven_findings.evidence: Iterates slot indices from zero to the imported session count and requires 0x0046B93C to report the slot active.
Skips either of two caller-supplied session indices at stack offsets +0x10 and +0x14.
Requires player-record fields +0xC8 and +0xC4 to equal the two caller-supplied room/source values.
Applies a visibility flag gate and two caller-controlled range/state gates against player fields +0x6F4 and +0x722.
A nonzero byte argument at +0x20 invokes 0x004733F4 for the recipient before output generation.
Uses the byte argument at +0x24 and recipient field +0x7D0 to index the table rooted at 0x0048F080, then calls 0x00478CD6.
Calls 0x0046B170 for the recipient, restores the shared output pointer, clears the buffer, and increments the return count only when player field +0x5F6 is zero.

negative_findings: No command-name or abbreviation table is consulted.
No command-handler pointer is selected or invoked.
